executive_summary:
Across 25 updates from 57 monitored organizations and web search, this week's evidence concentrated on general, mitigation energy, biodiversity nature. New monitored-site developments include Environmental and Social Sustainability , 2026 Triple Cop Year Business. Notable wider-intelligence items include Determining the Impact of Climate Change, When Actuaries See The Future: Climate R.

Category analysis: Adaptation Resilience (1): Media Resilience and Risk Comm; Biodiversity Nature (2): Philanthropy Key Change Climat, Processionary caterpillar outb; Catastrophe Natcat (3): WHO is on the Ground in Nepal , 2026 Rasuwa Flash Floods; Climate Disclosure (1): IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclo; Conference (1): Strengthening Urban Resilience; General (13): Environmental and Social Susta, 2026 Triple Cop Year Business; Health Mortality (1): The Climate and Health Risk In; Mitigation Energy (1): Carbon Dioxide Removal CDR Mar; Parametric Insurance (1): Developing Parametric Insuranc; Regulation Standards (1): Climate risk - International A.

Actuarial implications include: pricing and product design for climate-related perils, catastrophe modeling and hazard trends, scenario analysis and stress testing for transition risk, disclosure quality and reporting controls under IFRS S2, and growth of parametric insurance markets for climate adaptation.

Recommendations for the working group: (1) Monitor IFRS S2 implementation developments for actuarial reporting implications, (2) Track parametric insurance market growth for climate adaptation, (3) Review catastrophe model updates reflecting 2026 flood events, (4) Assess scenario analysis updates from NGFS and IPCC.
